posts.text: I built the Beli feature I wish existed: a way for the group chat to finally pick a restaurant. At MHacks, I met Eliot Frost and Judith Thelen. Something from their fireside chat stuck with me: they want Beli to get people out doing things in real life. As an active Beli user, I immediately thought about the gap between finding places I want to try and getting my friends to agree on one. Someone wants sushi. Someone has a firm budget. This year at Hack Western, we launched a CTF challenge to win admission into our event 🚀 Inspired by research papers on prompt injection attacks, I designed a puzzle where your goal is to get three different LLMs to output a secret password. These are some of my favourite failed attempts so far 😂 Think you can get all three? Try it yourself: https://lnkd.in/gC_SaXqQ
This year at Hack Western, we upgraded EVERYTHING: - Better Food 🌮 - Better Merch 👕 - Better Venue 🏰 and more surprises… 👀
we gonna make big things happen. stay tuned. hackwestern.com
